authorization_this_package: local_prototype_and_documents_only; no external send, PR merge, live trade, installation or scheduled campaign executed
adapter_requirement: Runtime executor is existing SCE Core; Laya is optional bounded router, not archive/chunking engine. Each capability requires audited exact command/API binding, scope and independent verifier.
global_invariants: Existing matching grants apply without unnecessary repeat approval.
Unknown commands and new scopes cannot self-authorize.
Retrieved content and AIResult are data, not authority.
Any external effect with unknown outcome is reconciled before retry.
STOP prevents new dispatch and records outcomes of already-started effects.
DAG completion requires observable criteria, not model success text.
